==== Mainworld Geography & Topography ====
Corella has three small oceans and deserts noted for spectacular coloured sands.

==== Mainworld Map ====
No information yet available.

=== Native Lifeforms ===
Abundant [[Lifeform|native life]] occupying every available ecological niche. Its metabolic functions drive the process of atmospheric renewal.

== History & Background / Dossier ==
Corella is the oldest continually inhabited Human world in the sector, not counting [[Mal'Gnar El (world)|Mal'Gnar El]].

While the government is captured by special interests from oligarchic Great Houses and the Consortia (a group of multi-world conglomerates dominating League commerce) Corella has successfully maintained a fairly free, peaceful society for most of its existence. It remains the heart of Human civilization in The Beyond.

=== World Starport ===
{{Starport|name= Corella|Starport=A}}
* There is an associated [[Naval Base]] of the Corellan League Star Fleet, to which Corella is a key contributor.

=== World Population (P) ===
{{WorldPop|name= Corella|multiplier= 8|Population= 8}}

==== World Demographics ====
* Human, 95%
* Small minorities of [[Kemlae]], [[Freni]], and others.
* The Aniyun Community of the Stars is an [[Aniyun]] population living at the orbital habitat to conduct League business.

==== Linguistic Topography ====
The common language is "[[Corellan Galanglic (language)|Corellan Galanglic]]", a distinct dialect of [[Anglic]].

==== World Timeline ====
* [[-1597]]: Corella settled by refugees from [[Htoleakh (world)|Oberon]].
* -1570: Settlement of [[Freya (Be 1414) (world)|Freya]] by loyalists of the [[Sindalian Empire]]. This original settlement is a forward base for an invasion of Corella that never takes place; most of the strike force is later withdrawn to deal with problems closer to home.
* -306: Vardarian Acts codify the gradual shift in power to the Great Houses and Consortia, granting them essentially monopolistic rights to certain industries.
